text: The Patriots are looking to get off the schneid against a rolling Steelers team in this week's home opener at Gillette Stadium, with the good news that running back TreVeyon Henderson says he's "ready to go" after missing Week 1 with an ankle injury, though the offense will face a tougher challenge without wide receiver A.J. Brown, who suffered a high ankle sprain that will sideline him for the next four weeks. On the roster front, the team made a practice squad swap by signing offensive lineman Xavier Newman-Johnson and releasing Jacob Rizy, while off the field, Patriots owner Robert Kraft confirmed he had Macklemore removed as an opening act for Ed Sheeran's Gillette Stadium shows due to what he described as a "history of antisemitic rhetoric and imagery." Meanwhile, in a poignant moment for the franchise, former All-Pro cornerback Stephon Gilmore will return to Foxborough on Friday to retire a Patriot, addressing the media at a press conference before Sunday's crucial matchup against Pittsburgh.
